Name: QuickEat
Author: hankan1918
Description:
✨ Features[list]
[*][b]One key eat[/b]: Press [b]V[/b] (configurable) to consume the currently held edible.
[*][b]Auto-confirm[/b]: Automatically selects [i]Yes[/i] on the eat dialog when needed.
[*][b]Safety checks[/b]: Blocks big craftables and non-edible items.
[*][b]Smooth chaining[/b]: Cleans up internal waiting state after animations so the hotkey keeps working.
[*][b]Multiplayer-friendly[/b]: Only players with the mod get the hotkey behavior; others are unaffected.
[/list]📦 Requirements[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]
[/list]🔧 Installation[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].
[*]Download the [b]QuickEat[/b] release [code].zip[/code].
[*]Extract so you have a folder:[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/QuickEat/ ├─ manifest.json[/code]
[code] └─ QuickEat.dll[/code]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.
[/list]🎮 Usage[list]
[*]Hold any [b]edible[/b] food in the toolbar.
[*]Press [b]V[/b] to eat it immediately.
[*]If the game would normally show a [i]Yes/No[/i] prompt, QuickEat will auto-confirm [i]Yes[/i].
[/list]⚙️ Configuration ([code]config.json[/code])Created on first run. Keys:KeyTypeDefaultDescription[quote]Tip: Edit [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/QuickEat/config.json[/code] while the game is closed (or use Generic Mod Config Menu if you have it).[/quote]
